meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到智能体群组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要管理多个频道与智能体群组的连接和权限隔离
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage connections and permission isolation between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你管理消息频道与智能体组的连接：查看当前配置、添加新频道、调整频道归属、设置隔离级别，并显示所有频道和用户权限的概览。
howto.when: 当你需要配置或修改消息频道（如 Telegram、Slack）与智能体组的关联时触发。通常在添加新频道后、初始设置期间，或单独运行以重新配置时使用。

say.text: 帮我查看当前所有频道和智能体组的连接情况。
say.note: Claude 会读取数据库并展示配置摘要。

say.text: 把 Telegram 群组“项目讨论”连接到“客服”智能体组，使用共享会话模式。
say.note: Claude 会执行注册命令并设置隔离级别。

say.text: 添加一个新的 Telegram 群组，让独立的智能体处理。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成配对和注册流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage the connection between messaging channels and agent groups: view current configuration, add new channels, reassign channels, set isolation levels, and display an overview of all channels and user permissions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to configure or modify the association between messaging channels (e.g., Telegram, Slack) and agent groups. Typically used after adding a new channel, during initial setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

say_en.text: Show me the current wiring of all channels and agent groups.
say_en.note: Claude reads the database and displays a configuration summary.

say_en.text: Connect the Telegram group "Project Chat" to the "Support" agent group with shared session mode.
say_en.note: Claude runs the register command and sets the isolation level.

say_en.text: Add a new Telegram group with a dedicated agent.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through pairing and registration.
